Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack is sitting on a bed, staring at the floor, his hands clenched into fists 💪.

DR. SMITH:
Alright, Jack, it's time for your medication. You know the drill 📚.

JACK:
I don't want to take them! They're poison! 💔

DR. SMITH:
(sighing) Jack, you need these pills to manage your symptoms. They're safe, I assure you 🙏.

JACK:
I don't believe you! You're just trying to control me! 🚫

DR. SMITH:
(frustrated) Jack, listen to me. I've been treating you for months. I know what's best for you 🤝.

JACK:
(getting up from the bed) I won't take them! You can't make me! 💥

DR. SMITH:
(firmly) Jack, please sit down. I'm not going to force you. But I will take them myself if I have to 🤯.

JACK:
(sneering) Oh, you think you're so smart, don't you? Well, I'll show you! 💪

Jack lunges at Dr. Smith, and the doctor is forced to grab him and hold him down 🤯. Jack struggles and kicks, but Dr. Smith manages to pin him to the bed 💪.

DR. SMITH:
(firmly) Jack, stop this. You're going to hurt yourself 🤕.

JACK:
(looking up at Dr. Smith with a maniacal grin) You'll never take me alive, copper! 💥

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in shock as he looks at Jack, and suddenly, Jack disappears into thin air 🔮. The doctor is left staring at an empty space, his eyes wide with confusion 🤯.

DR. SMITH:
(stunned) What...what just happened? 🤔

As the doctor looks around the room, he realizes that everything is just as it was before, but something is off 🤔. He looks down at his hands and sees that they are shaking, and his eyes are wild with a manic energy 💥.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering to himself) Am I...am I the one who's been delusional all along? 🤯

The camera zooms out as Dr. Smith's eyes widen in horror, and the screen fades to black 🎥.

FADE IN:

EXT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

The camera pans across the grounds, showing the patients walking and playing in the courtyard 🌞. But as the camera continues to pan, it becomes clear that Dr. Smith is standing in the center of the courtyard, staring at the camera with a wild look in his eye 🤪.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering) I'm the one who's been delusional all along... 🤯

The screen fades to black as the sound of Dr. Smith's maniacal laughter echoes through the courtyard 🎥.
